# Draft:The Centaurs (a filmmaking course)

"The Centaurs" is an experimental filmmaking course at the Institute of Screen Arts of in Kyiv National I. K. Karpenko-Kary Theatre, Cinema and Television University.
The name is also shared with a experimental creative association of students-filmmakers and the educational and production activities of the course. Films created during the course were showcased at open screenings and film-festivals in both Ukraine and abroad.
Name
The course is named after the Centaur, a creature from Greek mythology that is a combination of human and horse. Within the course, this image is used as a metaphor for a connection of different filmmaking professions. Students obtain directing, producing, scriptwriting and acting skills that are viewed as intertwined properties of any creative work.
History
"The Centaurs" course was established in the Institute of Screen Arts of in Kyiv National I. K. Karpenko-Kary Theatre, Cinema and Television University. Its activities are related to the educational process and creating students’ films within educational programs of the University. The art director of the course is a Ukrainian movie-director and producer Dmytro Tomashpolskyi, who carries out pedagogical and practical work with the students.
During the first term of the first year, students created one-minute short films. Each student had to create eight works over the semester. On December 21, 2024, the course had an open screening called “8½ cinematic works” (8½ kinovprav). This day is established as the course’s Birthday.
Also in 2024, students revived the International students’ film-festival “Prologue”. The same festival took place in 2025.
During the second term of the first-year students received another task on top of cinematic works. Every student had to make a contemporary adaptation of Ancient Greek myths. Through drawing lots each student got their myth. In the span of 6 months 25 short-films were created. They were showcased as an almanac “Myths: contemporary adaptations” in the Blue Hall of The Cinema House in Kyiv on June 8, 2025. Amid the showcase, the art director, Dmytro Tomashpolskii, initiated an annual prize “The Golden Centaur”. The student who best established themselves throughout the quality and quantity work was getting the prize. In June the prize was presented to two students – Iryna Zhydkova and Zakhar Shestiaiev. Apart from the showcase, the almanac was shown during the Ukrainian cinema week in Krakow and in Warsaw during the “Young Cinema” festival organized by the association of creative youth of Ukraine in Poland. Also, the films of the almanac were shown on 26 filmfestivals in the UK, the USA, Brazil, Romania, Sakartvelo, Italy and Greece. These films received honorable mentions and multiple special awards at festivals.
On the first term of the second-year, “The Centaurs” presented the next year’s program – “Genres: academia” (Zhanry: academia). Now students had to choose one literary work and make two adaptations (a comedy and a drama). Throughout the semester the course’s social media was booming with the news about the shooting process. On December 21, 2025 the first open screening of this program was conducted. During the Birthday showcase five short-films were shown in the Blue Hall of The Cinema House in Kyiv. At the end, the second showcase of “Genres: academia” was announced to take place on March 28, 2026.
Filmography
, "The Centaurs" have created more than 50 films in the span of “8½ cinematic works”, “Myths: contemporary adaptations” and “Genres: academia”.
